archetypes.name: timing-ledger-integrity
archetypes.rationale: The change depends on preserving ledger grammar while adding a derived timing row.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for timing-ledger correctness. Check that the new Gate B row cannot duplicate, cannot corrupt legacy rows, and cannot change round-end semantics. Pay special attention to start and end derivation from existing vendor rows. Cite each finding with exact file and test references. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
